keylist-tcloc.alt: Five T-CLOC inspection zones drawn as stations around a machine and walked as an ordered loop, numbered one to five from the marked start station and returning to it.

keylist-three-leaks.alt: A judgment reservoir with its level fallen, draining through three separate outlets of equal size: group gravity pulling the last rider along, familiarity discounting a repeated trail, and sunk momentum pushing on into failing light.

keylist-fit-checks.alt: A seated rider measured against four independent pass-or-fail gates - reach, stance, leverage and machine class - each drawn as a dimension that either fits between the gate posts or does not.

keylist-helmet-consequences.alt: A helmet cross-section with the crushable liner highlighted as the mechanism, and four causal arrows out to the rules that follow from it: worn and fastened, fitted, rated, and crushable only once.

keylist-stability-model.alt: One stability model at centre - centre of gravity held over the support base between the tires - with four applications around it: climbing slopes, side-hills, rider position as a control, and loads carried high.

keylist-four-families.alt: The four weather families split by what they degrade: water and light acting on the trail being read on the left, cold-and-heat and dust acting on the rider doing the reading on the right.

keylist-before-you-go.alt: The three before-you-go artifacts laid out before the ride: a ride plan with the route and turnaround marked, a communication plan naming who is told and when, and the carry kit strapped to the machine's rack.

keylist-stop-assess-communicate.alt: Stop, assess and communicate drawn as a strict three-stage sequence numbered one to three, each stage passing through a gate that only the previous stage opens.

keylist-pavement-physics.alt: Three engineering facts - a tire built to deform, a locked rear axle, and a high centre of gravity - with their arrows all converging on the same conclusion at the pavement.

keylist-good-crossing.alt: A road crossing broken into four numbered steps: stop completely at the bar, look both ways along the road, cross square to the road and briskly, and cross one machine at a time.

keylist-three-standards.alt: Three standards posted as signs at one trail junction - zero impairment, yielding generously to others, and staying on designated trail - applying to whichever branch is taken.
